subject: Voluntary unwind framework & request for exec approval on ramp/opt-out terms
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: j.rogers@acmehealth.com, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot - early unwind / opt-out questions

Diego —

Appreciate the work so far. Based on the board's latest guidance, Acme needs an explicit opt-out path for the pilot that allows a graceful exit at the end of month 2 without penalty. We also need a downsell option that reduces committed capacity by up to 40% if we decide not to proceed to full production.

Can Redwood provide a short framework (one page) describing what that would look like operationally and financially? Key asks:
- A clear ramp schedule (month-by-month committed tokens/GPU hours)
- A downsell protection that avoids an immediate termination penalty but preserves a partial credit for unused committed capacity
- Language on data retention and model QoS guarantees during the unwind window

We need to present something to procurement by Tuesday.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Partnerships, Acme Health

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: j.rogers@acmehealth.com, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot - early unwind / opt-out questions

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the clarity. Attached is a one-page "Voluntary Unwind" proposal and an annotated SOW showing the proposed ramp schedule. High level summary below:

- Ramp schedule (pilot): Month 0 (trial) -> Month 1: 30% commit -> Month 2: 70% commit -> Month 3: 100% commit (if converted)
- Opt-out window: Customer may elect an early unwind at the end of Month 2 with 30 days notice. If elected:
  - No termination fee if customer transitions to a Downsized Commitment (>=60% of prior committed tokens) for remaining term.
  - If customer chooses zero commitment, a one-time unwind fee equal to 15% of remaining committed value applies (to cover reserved capacity).
- Downsell protection: up to 40% reduction in committed capacity available once during the first 9 months post-conversion; reduction triggers prorated credit for unused committed capacity to be applied within 60 days.
- Data & QoS: Logs and audit trail retained for 90 days post-unwind; SLA tier maintained for remaining term on downsized commitments.

This deviates from our standard termination penalties (we typically apply 50% of remaining committed value) so I'm escalating for exec approval on the 15% unwind fee and the 40% one-time downsell allowance.

Attachments: Voluntary_Unwind_Proposal_v1.pdf; SOW_redlines_20270612.pdf

Can I pull in Marissa and Vivek for quick approval? We need a firm yes/no for procurement's deck by Tuesday morning.

—Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Voluntary unwind framework & request for exec approval on ramp/opt-out terms

Diego / Vivek —

Looping you in. TL;DR: Acme asks for an opt-out at end of month 2 with a downsell option up to 40%. Diego proposes a 15% unwind fee (non-standard) vs our usual 50%. Financial impact estimate attached (Billing_Schedule_v3.xlsx).

Ask for Vivek: approve the 15% unwind fee and the single 40% downsell carve-out for this deal only. Conditions I propose if approved:
1) One-time only during the first 9 months post-conversion.
2) Customer must provide 30 days written notice and complete a brief post-pilot health check with CS.
3) Any downsize requires reconfirmation of SLOs and updated billing schedule.

Marcus, please note revenue recognition and crediting flow if downsell applies.

Marissa
Director, Deal Desk (on rotation)
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 12:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Voluntary unwind framework & request for exec approval on ramp/opt-out terms

Marissa / Diego —

Review done. Approved with the conditions below:

1) Approve the 15% unwind fee as a concession for strategic enterprise pilot. This replaces our standard 50% early termination charge for this agreement only and requires sign-off from Legal and Finance.
2) Approve the one-time 40% downsell protection during months 1–9 post-conversion. Any further reductions revert to standard contract terms.
3) Require: (a) a signed amendment to the SOW that enumerates the downsell mechanics; (b) CS-led health check at the time of opt-out; (c) Marcus to confirm the crediting schedule (must not push ARR rebooking beyond quarter cutoffs without finance signoff).

Marcus — please confirm you can implement the crediting flow and flag any revenue recognition concerns. If you see issues, escalate to me directly.

Vivek
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: j.rogers@acmehealth.com, procurement@acmehealth.com, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Voluntary unwind framework & request for exec approval on ramp/opt-out terms

Samantha —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Executive approval granted by Redwood with the following terms (summary):
- Early unwind allowed at end of Month 2 with 30 days notice.
- If customer elects to remain with a Downsized Commitment >=60% (i.e., up to 40% reduction), there is no unwind fee; prorated credit for unused committed capacity applies and CS will validate QoS.
- If customer elects zero commitment after opt-out, a one-time unwind fee of 15% of remaining committed value applies.
- Legal & Finance must sign the SOW amendment; Marcus will confirm crediting timeline.

Attached: Voluntary_Unwind_Proposal_v1.pdf (final), SOW_redlines_20270612.pdf (pending amendment).

Next steps: I'll send the SOW amendment draft to your procurement contact and propose a short amendment call Tuesday 10:00 AM PT. Please confirm.

Best,
Diego
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Voluntary_Unwind_Proposal_v1.pdf (1 page), SOW_redlines_20270612.pdf (annotated)
